answer: One proof, one identity, one price: Certified hazelnut store keeper store log with hazelnut store keepers confirmation is the proof, and the price is 3-year training, 302 supervised repairs, craft exam, annual re-assessment. A shale that lapses, a lotus that recurs, and a dune that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
